name: cod-ab-eth
title: Ethiopia - Subnational Administrative Boundaries
license_title: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
dataset_source: CSA (Central Statistics Agency) + Regional Bureau of Finance and Economic Development (BoFED)
caveats:
In the administrative boundary dataset, two administrative level 3 units cannot be represented on maps because of their contested boundaries, but they are being used in all types of analysis. These are Dawe Serer (ET042199) in Oromia region and Quarsadula (ET050905) in Somali region. These two are included on HDX in other datasets, for example on the population statistics and humanitarian profile, and in the gazetteer provided with this dataset (1150 woredas).
Administrative boundaries and capital locations are derived from the latest official datasets available. They are provided for reference only and may not reflect all current administrative realities on the ground.

Use the disclaimer provided here on your maps/products: 
The boundaries and names shown and the designations used on this data do not imply official endorsement or acceptance by the United
Nations.Reference to ‘contested areas’ are understood within the context of the Pretoria Agreement [Article 10, 2022].

Note on admin capitals: Addis Ababa serves as the national capital and admin1 capital for Addis Ababa and Oromia regions.

name: cod-ab-nga
title: Nigeria - Subnational Administrative Boundaries
license_title: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
dataset_source: Office for the Surveyor General of the Federation of Nigeria (OSGOF), Ehealth, United Nations Cartographic Section (UNCS)
caveats:
ADM2 feature "Bakassi" [NG009005] is not represented in the COD-PS, but is thought to be uninhabited. Any actual population will be incorporated in the "Akpabuyo" ]NG009003] COD-PS record. Admin level 3 are developed for operational purposes only. Two wards in the Administrative registry file (Sagir and Wurge) in Ngala, Borno State are not demarcated in the shapefile due to access constraint. The COD replaces the following datasets:
https://data.humdata.org/dataset/nigeria-admin-level-0-1-and-2-administrative-boundaries
https://data.humdata.org/dataset/nigeria-borno-operational-boundaries-admin-1-3-state-lga-ward

name: cod-ab-cod
title: Democratic Republic of the Congo - Subnational Administrative Boundaries
license_title: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
caveats:
[HDX dataset name edited 2018 05 10]
Tous les territoires ruraux,  les communes urbaines sont en cours d’intégration. Etant donné le changement de codification INS opéré en mai 2008, la structure des Pcode a été adaptée mais les localités existantes dans la base conservent leur Pcode même si leur position géographique est ajustée par la suite. Un Pcode disparaît donc si et seulement si la localité correspondante est éliminée de la base (car il a été prouvé qu’elle n’existe pas sur le terrain). Ce code ne sera en aucun cas affecté à une nouvelle localité. La couche admin3 ne reflète pas la configuration réelle des limites de différentes entités, le travail de mise à jour se poursuit par les différents membres du groupe de travail IM.
